title: 1.3 Applications of Information Systems
description: E-Government, E-banking, E-learning, E-commerce, Telemedicine and Teleconference

questions.question: What is e-Government?
options: The use of information systems to provide electronic services to citizens with the purpose of increasing efficiency, transparency, and citizen participation
The buying and selling of goods over the Internet
A form of learning delivered through digital devices
The practice of caring for patients at a distance
questions.correctAnswer: The use of information systems to provide electronic services to citizens with the purpose of increasing efficiency, transparency, and citizen participation

questions.question: What is a portal?
options: A web-based information system that collects information from different sources into a single user interface
A computer that stores employee salaries
A series of steps followed to achieve a goal
A set of instructions that commands the hardware
questions.correctAnswer: A web-based information system that collects information from different sources into a single user interface

questions.question: Which of the following municipal services can be automated and made accessible for citizens over a web portal?
options: Business registrations, auto registry, payment of taxes, issuance of birth certificates, and issuance and renewal of identification cards
Baking bread and cooking meals
Farming and harvesting crops
Building roads and bridges
questions.correctAnswer: Business registrations, auto registry, payment of taxes, issuance of birth certificates, and issuance and renewal of identification cards

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit of adopting e-government solutions?
options: Establishing trust between governments and citizens
Requiring citizens to go to municipalities in person
Stopping the sharing of information between agencies
Increasing the cost of running government services
questions.correctAnswer: Establishing trust between governments and citizens

questions.question: With e-government services, customers can pay their monthly electric bill through which device?
options: Their mobile phones
A paper coupon
A horse and cart
A landline telegram
questions.correctAnswer: Their mobile phones

questions.question: What does the traditional banking service demand of customers?
options: Going to the bank in person and waiting their turns to get a service
Using the Internet to make payments
Withdrawing cash from an ATM
Checking balances from home
questions.correctAnswer: Going to the bank in person and waiting their turns to get a service

questions.question: What is electronic banking?
options: A form of technology-based banking service that avoids exchange of cash, checks, or other types of paper documents
A form of banking that requires customers to visit branches every day
A form of banking that uses paper receipts only
A form of banking limited to government offices
questions.correctAnswer: A form of technology-based banking service that avoids exchange of cash, checks, or other types of paper documents

questions.question: In the banking sector, IT is mainly associated with which services?
options: Internet banking, Automated Teller Machine (ATM), and mobile banking
Postal money orders and telegrams
Checkbooks and passbooks only
Safe deposit boxes and cash registers
questions.correctAnswer: Internet banking, Automated Teller Machine (ATM), and mobile banking

questions.question: Which of the following are commonly known e-banking services?
options: Automatic Teller Machine (ATM), Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, Credit cards, Debit Cards, Smart Cards, and Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) System
Postal stamps, envelopes, and parcels
Telegrams, faxes, and telex machines
Paper checks, cashiers, and vaults only
questions.correctAnswer: Automatic Teller Machine (ATM), Mobile Banking, Internet Banking, Credit cards, Debit Cards, Smart Cards, and Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) System

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit of e-banking?
options: The cost of operation per unit of services is lower for banks
Customers must always visit the bank branch
Customers have to wait for long queues
Banks must hire more cashiers at branches
questions.correctAnswer: The cost of operation per unit of services is lower for banks

questions.question: With e-banking, customers can withdraw cash at any time using which service?
options: ATM service
A post office counter
A money lender
A street vendor
questions.correctAnswer: ATM service

questions.question: Which of the following is a challenge of e-banking?
options: Digital theft
Immediate transaction messages
Lower cost of operation for banks
Easy account balance checking
questions.correctAnswer: Digital theft

questions.question: What is e-learning?
options: A form of learning delivered through the use of digital devices
A form of banking over the Internet
A form of government service delivery
A form of caring for patients remotely
questions.correctAnswer: A form of learning delivered through the use of digital devices

questions.question: Which of the following terms is also used to describe e-learning?
options: Online learning, virtual learning, distributed learning, and computer-based learning
Postal learning and telegraph learning
Correspondence via pigeon mail
Classroom board learning only
questions.correctAnswer: Online learning, virtual learning, distributed learning, and computer-based learning

questions.question: If e-learning is provided over the Internet, what is it referred to as?
options: Online learning
Paper learning
Street learning
Market learning
questions.correctAnswer: Online learning

questions.question: Which of the following are the main components of e-learning?
options: The Internet, computers or mobile phones, digital learning resources, content developers, and learners
Chalkboards, chalk, and erasers
Textbooks, exercise books, and pens
Exams, report cards, and principals
questions.correctAnswer: The Internet, computers or mobile phones, digital learning resources, content developers, and learners

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit that e-learning offers to learners?
options: Flexibility in learning time
Fixed class schedules
High travel expenses
Physical isolation from resources
questions.correctAnswer: Flexibility in learning time

questions.question: Which of the following is a disadvantage of e-learning?
options: Physical isolation of students from teachers and other students
Flexibility in learning time
Access to a variety of educational resources
Reduced educational costs
questions.correctAnswer: Physical isolation of students from teachers and other students

questions.question: What is e-commerce?
options: The buying and selling of goods and services over the Internet
The use of computers in schools only
The practice of caring for patients remotely
The provision of banking services by mail
questions.correctAnswer: The buying and selling of goods and services over the Internet

questions.question: E-commerce is fundamentally which of the following?
options: A website deployed over the Internet to handle online transactions
A physical market in the city center
A paper catalogue delivered by post
A series of radio advertisements
questions.correctAnswer: A website deployed over the Internet to handle online transactions

questions.question: Which actors are involved in e-commerce transactions?
options: Merchants, buyers or customers, banks, and transporters
Farmers, bakers, and barbers only
Teachers, students, and librarians
Doctors, nurses, and pharmacists
questions.correctAnswer: Merchants, buyers or customers, banks, and transporters

questions.question: Avoiding intermediaries in e-commerce allows customers to do what?
options: Buy products directly from manufacturers at a cheaper price avoiding wholesalers and retailers
Pay higher prices for products
Visit many physical stores
Wait for seasonal sales only
questions.correctAnswer: Buy products directly from manufacturers at a cheaper price avoiding wholesalers and retailers

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of e-commerce?
options: Increased bargaining power for the customer
Higher prices from local merchants
Limited access to global markets
Extra travel costs for buyers
questions.correctAnswer: Increased bargaining power for the customer

questions.question: What is telemedicine?
options: The practice of caring for patients remotely without the caregiver and the patient being in the same physical location
The practice of teaching students online
The practice of selling goods over the Internet
The practice of paying bills through a bank
questions.correctAnswer: The practice of caring for patients remotely without the caregiver and the patient being in the same physical location

questions.question: Telemedicine was originally introduced to treat which group of patients?
options: Patients who were in remote places, far away from local health facilities, or in areas with shortages of medical professionals
Patients who live next to a hospital
Patients with very small medical bills
Patients who prefer paper prescriptions
questions.correctAnswer: Patients who were in remote places, far away from local health facilities, or in areas with shortages of medical professionals

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of telemedicine for patients?
options: Overcoming geographical barriers to access health care services
Paying more for travel and hotel services
Waiting months for a doctor appointment
Visiting clinics in person for every checkup
questions.correctAnswer: Overcoming geographical barriers to access health care services

questions.question: What is a teleconference?
options: A meeting of two or more people who are separated by distance using electronic communication
A meeting where all participants sit in one room
A market where people sell goods online
A classroom where students use computers
questions.correctAnswer: A meeting of two or more people who are separated by distance using electronic communication

questions.question: What are the two popular forms of teleconferencing?
options: Audio conferencing and video conferencing
Paper conferencing and mail conferencing
Street conferencing and market conferencing
Telephone conferencing and postal conferencing
questions.correctAnswer: Audio conferencing and video conferencing
